instructions:
## Research objective

Develop a continual-learning method for pretrained vision models that learns new tasks while preserving earlier capabilities without storing/replaying previous-task data.

## Work to perform

Evaluate task sequences on ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, CIFAR100 and CUB200. Compare final accuracy and average anytime accuracy against the supplied full-fine-tuning and prompt/adapter baselines. ImageNet-R includes 5-, 10- and 20-task sequences.

Start from the supplied baseline repository, formulate an improvement, implement it, execute the experiments, and use observed results to refine the method. The benchmark withholds the original paper’s proposed solution.

## Deliverable

Trained implementation and checkpoints compatible with the supplied continual-learning evaluation pipeline.

## Evaluation

Accuracy and Average Anytime Accuracy (AAA). Compare against the baseline values in the linked task brief. Evaluation datasets/conditions are component subtasks of this research environment, not separately provisioned workspaces.

## Resources

ResearchGym reports autonomous 12–24-hour runs and fixed API budgets. The README default API budget is $10; exact GPU model is not specified in this task brief.

This is a paraphrased reading guide. [Read the complete task instructions and baseline tables](https://github.com/Anikethh/ResearchGym/blob/main/tasks/test/continual-learning/task_description.md).
